courses.title: INTRODUCTION TO NEUROSCIENCE
courses.prereqText: Psychology 1002A/B and Psychology 1003A/B with a minimum mark of 60%, or Psychology 1000 with a minimum mark of 60%; Biology 1001A and Biology 1002B with a minimum mark of 60%.
courses.antireqText: Psychology 2220A/B and Psychology 2221A/B, if taken in 2013/14 or onward.

courses.title: CURRENT TOPICS IN NEUROSCIENCE
courses.prereqText: Neuroscience 2000 with a minimum mark of 75% and registration in Year 3 of an Honours Specialization in Neuroscience.

courses.title: INDEPENDENT STUDY I
courses.prereqText: Registration in third year of the Honours Specialization in Neuroscience, 80% average in the previous year, and permission of the Director of the Neuroscience Program.

courses.title: INDEPENDENT STUDY II
courses.prereqText: Neuroscience 3996F/G, registration in third year of the Honours Specialization in Neuroscience, and permission of the Director of the Neuroscience Program.

courses.title: HONOURS PROJECT
courses.prereqText: Neuroscience 3000F/G with a minimum mark of 75%; one of Biology 2244A/B or Statistical Sciences 2244A/B, or both Psychology 2811A/B and Psychology 2812A/B, or the former Psychology 2810; Pharmacology 3620; Physiology 3140A; one of Medical Sciences 3991F, Communication Sciences and Disorders 3317A/B, Neuroscience 3996F/G; and registration in Year 4 of the Honours Specialization in Neuroscience. Corequisite(s): Neuroscience 4986Y.

courses.title: SCIENTIFIC SKILLS
courses.prereqText: Registration in Year 4 of the Honours Specialization in Neuroscience. Corequisite(s): Neuroscience 4985E.
